facts.fact: Kirkby is formed from the hamlets of Soutergate, Wall End, Beck Side, Sand Side, Marshside and Chapels, so pool, sauna and hot-tub installers should expect a dispersed service area rather than one compact town centre.
facts.label: LOCAL CHARACTER

facts.fact: Much of the village’s housing and infrastructure grew with the Burlington Slate Quarries, and houses at Marshside and Incline Foot were built for quarry workers; this creates a distinctive stock of older stone properties where access, flooring, drainage and structural loading should be assessed before installing spas or swim spas.
facts.label: LOCAL CHARACTER

facts.fact: Kirkby-in-Furness is primarily a commuter village that still supports slate and agricultural work, making scheduled maintenance and servicing practical for homeowners who may need planned visits around commuting patterns.
facts.label: LOCAL CHARACTER

facts.fact: The village is served by Kirkby-in-Furness railway station on the Cumbrian Coast Line between Carlisle and Barrow-in-Furness, a useful local reference point when describing service coverage and arranging access.
facts.label: LOCAL CHARACTER

facts.fact: St Cuthbert’s Church dates from about 1170, Kirkby Hall has a 15th-century east wing and a 16th-century west wing, and the listed station footbridge is associated with the former Furness Railway; the area therefore contains heritage-sensitive buildings where external plant, pipework and delivery routes may need especially careful treatment.
facts.label: LANDMARKS

labels.PROPERTY TYPES: Traditional stone cottages and terraces, especially quarry-worker housing at Marshside and Incline Foot, largely associated with the Burlington Slate Quarries’ 19th-century expansion; older farmhouses and country houses include medieval-to-16th-century buildings such as Kirkby Hall, while newer rural and commuter housing has been added in the 20th and 21st centuries.
labels.NEIGHBOURHOODS: Soutergate, Wall End, Beck Side, Sand Side, Marshside, Chapels, Incline Foot
labels.LANDMARKS: St Cuthbert’s Church, Kirkby Hall, Kirkby-in-Furness railway station, Burlington Slate Quarries, The Long Incline, Duddon Sands
labels.LOCAL CHARACTER: Kirkby-in-Furness is a dispersed rural village made up of six hamlets, locally usually shortened to “Kirkby,” with a strong slate-quarrying history alongside farming and commuting. Its housing is predominantly traditional stone, and the ageing population, high house prices and limited first-time-buyer stock can mean a mixed market of established homes, quarry heritage properties and newer rural development.

hubs.title: Wood-Fired Hot Tubs
hubs.contentNote: Lead the page with wood-fired tubs as David sells them: most buyers choose the model with hydrotherapy jets and LED lights, which plug into a standard 13-amp socket for the jets and lights only (the stove does the heating). The completely off-grid starter model exists but is a small share of sales, so it is a section, not the headline (David's WhatsApp, 6 Oct 2026). The range is made by Kubilų pasaulis, so name it: 'Cumbria Spas works in partnership with Kubilų pasaulis, the largest manufacturer in Lithuania of premium, luxury and custom hot tubs' (approved by the operator on 4 Nov 2026 for every page, articles included. That it is the largest manufacturer in Lithuania is the manufacturer's own claim and already on the live site; 'premium, luxury and custom hot tubs' is the operator's wording. Attribute it to Kubilų pasaulis and never make it a claim about Cumbria Spas). Never call it just 'a Lithuanian manufacturer'. Keep the live site's advantages: renewable wood heat with less reliance on electricity, off-grid use, the traditional bathing experience with the natural aroma of burning wood, and lower running costs with your own wood. Heat-up, temperature control by the stove vent, and the digital thermometer are in SITE-PLAN.md Section 1. The hero image must be a wood-fired tub. On this page and in every article, say in passing that Cumbria Spas serves residential and commercial customers of all types, from hotels to spas to leisure centres. Every call to action reads 'Contact by the quote form, call now, or by WhatsApp.' No prices anywhere: 'contact for prices' or 'contact for a quote'.

hubs.title: Hot Tub Repair & Servicing
hubs.contentNote: THE REPAIR AND SERVICING HUB (operator, 3 Nov 2026). Articles are 'Hot Tub Repair and Servicing in [Town]', for people searching 'hot tub repair <town>' and 'hot tub servicing <town>'. Cover, from SITE-PLAN.md Section 1 ('Product and service detail'): residential AND commercial hot tubs; the service itself step by step (the live site's nine-step service: line flush with jets on full power for 45 minutes, drain, vacuum the footwell and every jet line, clean the shell, lid and steps, inspect and clean the filters, refill and balance the chemicals); automated pH balancing and chemical dosing (what David described: domestic tubs need manual chemical balancing, automated dosing comes with a commercial spa and plant room, and Arctic Spas' Spa Boy is the domestic route to automated saltwater water care); plant-room maintenance, servicing and repair for commercial spas; leaking and neglected tubs; and a short mention of installation, linking to the installation hub (most of the business is installs; this hub is the repair and servicing angle). Coverage wording: Cumbria, North Lancashire and North Yorkshire. No service price is published: contact for a quote. On this page and in every article, say in passing that Cumbria Spas serves residential and commercial customers of all types, from hotels to spas to leisure centres. Every call to action reads 'Contact by the quote form, call now, or by WhatsApp.'

hubs.title: Electric Hot Tubs
hubs.contentNote: The electric version of the Kubilų pasaulis range: the same tub shapes as the wood-fired range, from the same manufacturer (use the partnership wording on the wood-fired hub; never 'a Lithuanian manufacturer'). The trade-off to explain is convenience against heat-up time (an electric tub takes 14 to 16 hours from cold, per David), and electric tubs are governed to about 40°C. Cross-link to the wood-fired hub and the Arctic Spas hub. The hero image must be an electric tub. On this page and in every article, say in passing that Cumbria Spas serves residential and commercial customers of all types, from hotels to spas to leisure centres. Every call to action reads 'Contact by the quote form, call now, or by WhatsApp.' No prices anywhere: 'contact for prices' or 'contact for a quote'.

hubs.title: Hot Tub Installation
hubs.contentNote: Installs are most of the business. Give the technical detail a buyer needs: a wood-fired tub arrives by 4x4 and trailer and is lifted into place with a HIAB crane; an Arctic Spa is installed with one of Arctic's own engineers; commercial and mosaic-tiled spas are installed in-house, plant room included. hubs.title: Commercial & Mosaic-Tiled Spas
hubs.contentNote: Residential, commercial and B2B: hotels, spa-day venues, leisure centres, holiday parks and homeowners who want a mosaic-tiled spa instead of acrylic. Most models run from a plant room; some domestic models build the plant into the spa (one has an exposed side showing the heater and pumps). Hydro spas, about 4 m x 3-3.5 m up to about 5.5 m x 4.5 m, hold 15 to 20 people. Automated dosing, glass filtration, bespoke CAD-designed spas, and the build and test detail (GRP shell, 24-hour water test, 70-point check) are in SITE-PLAN.md Section 1. The manufacturer has been family-run since 1965: say so, attributed to the manufacturer and never to Cumbria Spas (established 2013). Lead times are 6 to 10 weeks on most orders (David, WhatsApp 20 Oct 2026). Swim spas have their own hub, Swimming Pools & Swim Spas: cross-link it. hubs.title: Trade and Holiday Park Hot Tubs
hubs.contentNote: B2B only, for holiday parks, lodge and glamping sites and other letting businesses, not individual buyers. David has supplied and serviced many holiday parks: say so. The trade terms are for the Kubilų pasaulis range (hot tubs and saunas). Qualifying: a British company registered at Companies House, VAT registered, ordering at least three units (hot tubs and saunas can be mixed). Priced in euros at trade rates (contact for prices); delivered to the buyer's site, unloading arranged by the buyer, and a parts-only warranty because Cumbria Spas does not install trade orders (14 Aug 2026 call). Servicing afterwards: link the Hot Tub Repair & Servicing hub. Other hot tub types for holiday parks are sub-topics of these articles.
